proposedAdditionalDirectPairs.individuallyBoundedJapaneseSenseClaim: Payment change versus the independently recorded あまり remainder noun, not the negative-degree adverb or unrestricted あんまり noun reading; cash remainder is the narrow overlap.
Barbershop establishment versus standalone みせ establishment/shop, not the barber person or suffix てん; a barbershop is not thereby every retail store.
Actual alcoholic-drink sense overlaps お酒; chemical ingredient/disinfectant is not an interchangeable beverage.
Alcoholic beverage is a drink, but substance alcohol is not every beverage; direct limited drink reference, not an unrestricted category equivalence.
Substitution/replacing noun versus replacing/exchanging action; preserve noun versus transitive verb grammar and participant roles. Not a license to substitute verb into の代わりに.
Seat versus chair/seat furniture and separately recorded post/position senses; no claim that every assigned/floor seat is a movable chair; actual runtime provider is いす, not nonexistent 椅子 file.
Standalone 席 location/place of a gathering overlaps a place/location; seat is narrower, and 場所 sumo-tournament sense is not automatically transferred.
Seat/gathering location versus standalone ところ place; not an inference from place-counter しょ/じょ or a suffix-only construction.
The independently recorded gathering-location sense of 席 can name the venue, not only an individual sitting place; no general seat/building equivalence.
Both have separately recorded position/post nouns; this does not equate a seat with a mailbox, goalpost, online post or post- prefix.
席 position/post versus 仕事 job/employment in the limited employment-role domain; not physical seat versus work/labour or physics work. Independently bounded, not inherited through ポスト.
戦争 separately records fierce competition and fighting; 競争 is competition/rivalry. Literal war is not an ordinary neutral match; modern necessity/frequency unverified.
Quarrel/physical fight versus separately recorded fighting use of 戦争; not every quarrel a literal war and not a transitive 喧嘩–競争 proposal.
Equipment breakdown/out-of-order state overlaps breaking/malfunctioning; preserve intransitive が, and do not require visible smashed pieces.
The separately recorded bodily injury sense of 故障 overlaps injury, with patient/body-part roles qualified; not equipment fault equals every wound or injury caused to someone else.
Both independently record trouble/problem/hindrance; not equipment fault equals every exam question, research subject or doubt.
故障 separately records objection/protest; 反対 records objection/opposition. Not malfunction equals reverse direction; ordinary modern use/necessity unverified.
Both independently record obstacle/hindrance/difficulty senses; not equipment fault equals a physical wall, astronomical へき or all barriers.
Malfunction/out-of-order versus independently recorded broken/not serving purpose state; not a fault equals prohibition, interjection or go neutral point.
Standalone business/task/errand nouns overlap directly; intended-use suffix and excretion sense are separate, not children's errands in 子ども用.
Standalone business/task/errand versus work/job/business/task; not a suffix-only lift from 仕事用, and not every employment or physics-work sense.
Standalone use/purpose versus use/utilization noun/する; no interchangeable suffix grammar or assertion that an errand means exploitation.
Standalone use noun and using action have a limited lexical overlap; preserve noun/suffix versus transitive verb, not a claim that 用 itself conjugates.
Rule/regulation versus binding law in the narrow normative-rule domain; a school rule is not automatically legislation.
約束 independently records convention/rule as a noun; not every promise, appointment or destiny is a regulation.
Relationship/connection versus separately recorded formal/literary matter-to-matter relation/link; not every contact, call or train connection; modern necessity/frequency unverified.
間 あいだ independently records relations/relationship; not room/pause ま, archaic conjunction, suffix-only between or a shared English 'between' inference.
Separately recorded influence/effect versus influence/control noun/する; not left/right directions or rare とかく/とにかく readings, and not identical transitivity.
Mistake/blunder noun/する versus making a mistake/doing incorrectly; preserve undertaking failure versus incorrect detail and nominal versus transitive-verb grammar.
Mistake/blunder versus independently recorded wrong/incorrect/mistaken predicate, a limited error-domain protection; not all differences are failures or all wrong states failed attempts.
Failure/failed attempt versus separately recorded failure at exam/contest; not literal falling, all decreases or all endings.
Failure versus independently recorded failed examination/falling-flat joke senses; not sliding motion or rare ぬめる sliminess; actual modern frequency/necessity unverified.
怪我 separately records mistake/accident/loss, not only bodily injury; limited mistake sense protection, not failed attempt equals every injury or inherited through 故障.
Direct answer/reply/response noun overlap; solution to a problem need not be a reply to a person, nor is either automatically correct.
Answer/reply noun versus answering/replying action; preserve 答/答え noun spelling and verb conjugation, not use of bare 答 as a verb.
Reply/response noun versus separately recorded respond/retort/reply/say-back standalone verb; not physical return or suffix-only -返す.

Answer/response noun versus independently recorded go-game answering/responding action, with field and grammar restricted; not receiving property or taking/passing an exam; modern quiz necessity unverified.

meaningfulRejectedComparisons.reason: Equipment breakdown is an intransitive event/state, not automatically the causative action breaking something; no unqualified actor/patient merge.
Equipment malfunction versus an unsuccessful attempt/mistake; shared English failure alone is not Japanese lexical proof.
Quarrelling is not neutral competing; no transitive closure through 戦争.
The inspected standalone 用 entry does not supply a need/necessity sense; a use or errand does not become necessity through English glosses.
Use/purpose is not the useful predicate merely because a construction can say something serves a purpose.
A seat/entity or post is not attendance or sitting action merely by a shared character or common setting.
Trade-direction opposites, not duplicate meanings; one shipment can be described from two different country perspectives.
No automatic export/import meaning lifted from a compound component or generic putting into a room.
No automatic international-export meaning lifted from a compound component, generic taking out, posting a letter or publishing.

meaningfulRejectedComparisons.comparison: 貿易–取り替える/買い物
meaningfulRejectedComparisons.reason: Cross-border commerce is not an ordinary item swap or neighbourhood shopping; the English trade gloss alone does not erase the boundary.
A marriage and an abstract relationship/connection are different lexical referents; not a relationship-family clique.
Failure/mistake is not automatically a useless/broken state or prohibition; no pair inferred solely from an unsuccessful plan.
An eraser is not erasing action or a pencil; no compound-component/tool/activity lift.
Material versus specific stationery item remains explicit; ゴム is also absent from current runtime and not a provider.
Forecast versus actual weather; no duplicate meaning just because a weather forecast discusses weather.
